info.title: Nautical Universal API
info.description: Access Nautical marketplace data through the authenticated Traide GraphQL API using a tenant-specific bearer token and tenant header.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
